title: Reach the Pack-specific instructions
when: After selecting a Pack, before treating it as suitable or ready
need: Read the selected Pack README and its application/runbook children; its installed files become project-owned source. A Pack description is not its setup or support contract.
surface: Catalog JSON has documentation; installed entry is docs/packs/<slug>/README.md. Plain packs list output prints description/tools but omits that documentation pointer.
gap: Proven narrow omission in human list output. Pre-install availability of complete Pack docs and actual workbench link behavior are not established.
